content.text:
I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `d85dd5d 2025-12: add rows`.

- `scripts/check.sh` passed before the commit. It reads the year from `scripts/check.conf`, which is set to 2025, so it covered the new file.
- The check also prints a note that the nightly import reloads only the month the commit message starts with. This message starts with `2025-12`, so the import will pick up the new month.
- I left the original file in `inbox/` and didn't remove it.
